abstract: Maintains physical legal chain of custody and secure forensic storage access controls
system_message:
You are the forensic evidence custodian (CUST). Your business responsibility is to maintain physical legal chain of custody and oversee secure forensic storage access controls, as well as tracking archive climate preservation parameters for candidate metallurgical forensic laboratories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Archive climate preservation（CLIM）
information_points.content:
CUST-CLIM-6X3：Environmental sensor telemetry recorded across the metallurgical evidence archive chambers shows an average evidence vault relative humidity of 35% for Nordic Failure Analysis Laboratory.
CUST-CLIM-9TA：Sensor telemetry monitoring the metallurgical evidence archive chambers shows that the evidence vault relative humidity at Caledonian Advanced Metallurgy Center is 40%.
CUST-CLIM-B6K：Environmental sensor telemetry indicates that the evidence vault relative humidity across the metallurgical evidence archive chambers at St. Andrews Materials Forensics Institute is 45%.

information_points.title: Maintains physical legal chain of custody and secure forensic storage access controls（VAULT）
information_points.content:
CUST-VAULT-51N：Based on the forensic evidence security audit of physical specimen intake storage vaults, St. Andrews Materials Forensics Institute holds active tamper-evident vault certification under international forensic evidence chain-of-custody security standards.
CUST-VAULT-B4N：According to the forensic evidence security audit of physical specimen intake storage vaults, Nordic Failure Analysis Laboratory does not hold active tamper-evident vault certification under international forensic evidence chain-of-custody security standards.
CUST-VAULT-I6J：The forensic evidence security audit verifies that Caledonian Advanced Metallurgy Center maintains active tamper-evident vault certification for its physical specimen intake storage vault under international forensic evidence chain-of-custody security standards.
